tasks.title: Scaffold monorepo, tooling, CI and install all workspace dependencies
tasks.description: Contract-first: create every workspace manifest and install the dependencies listed in PLAN.md section 'Tech stack' now, so later tasks don't fight over package manifests and the lockfile.
acceptance: `pnpm install` succeeds from a clean clone
`pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` pass on the empty workspaces
CI workflow runs lint, typecheck and test on pull requests

tasks.title: Spike: choose the session strategy (server sessions vs tokens)
tasks.description: Research spike that T09 depends on. Read PLAN.md 'Security'; check the libraries already chosen in T01. Output a short decision record.
acceptance: Report compares at least 2 options on security, revocation, CSRF exposure and complexity
Report ends with one recommendation and the reasons

tasks.title: Shared domain schemas and types
tasks.description: These schemas are the contract both apps build against; keep them stable once merged. Include the role enum and the task status workflow.
acceptance: Schemas for User, Workspace, Membership, Project, Task, Comment, Label exported from packages/shared
Unit tests cover valid and invalid payloads for each schema
`pnpm --filter shared test` passes

tasks.title: API skeleton: config, error handling, health check, module auto-loading
tasks.description: Auto-loading modules removes a classic merge hotspot: feature tasks add a module directory and never touch a shared registry. New dependencies after T01: add them to this workspace's package.json, run the install, and report it under out_of_scope_changes (the manager re-runs the install on lockfile conflicts).
acceptance: GET /health returns 200 with a JSON body
Unknown routes return a JSON 404 in the shared error format
Modules under src/modules/*/ are registered automatically, with no central route file to edit

tasks.title: Web skeleton: build setup, app shell, feature route discovery
tasks.description: Feature tasks must not edit a central router. verify: the bundler's glob-import feature for route discovery. New dependencies after T01: add them to this workspace's package.json, run the install, and report it under out_of_scope_changes (the manager re-runs the install on lockfile conflicts).
acceptance: `pnpm --filter web dev` serves the app shell
Routes declared in src/features/*/routes.tsx are discovered automatically
A smoke test renders the shell

tasks.title: API integration test harness with an ephemeral database
tasks.description: Every API task after this writes integration tests with this harness.
acceptance: `pnpm --filter api test` starts an isolated database per run and tears it down
Example integration test against /health passes

tasks.title: Database access, migration runner and core schema (users, workspaces, memberships)
acceptance: Migrations apply cleanly to an empty database and are re-runnable
Unique constraint on user email
Membership has a role column using the shared role enum

tasks.title: User repository and password hashing
acceptance: Passwords are hashed with a memory-hard algorithm (argon2id preferred, bcrypt acceptable); plaintext is never stored or logged
Integration tests cover create, find-by-email, and duplicate email

tasks.title: Auth endpoints: signup, login, logout
acceptance: Signup, login and logout work end to end in integration tests
Login failures return the same error for unknown email and wrong password
Session or token handling follows the T02 decision

tasks.title: Auth guard and request context
acceptance: Protected routes return 401 without a valid session
Handlers can read the current user from the request context

tasks.title: Authorization policies for workspace roles
tasks.description: Central place for permission checks; resource modules call it instead of re-implementing role logic.
acceptance: Policy functions decide owner, admin, member and viewer permissions for every resource type
Table-driven tests cover each role and action, including denial cases

tasks.title: Security hardening: rate limits, security headers, CSRF and CORS
acceptance: Login and signup are rate limited per IP and per account
Security headers present on every response
CSRF protection on state-changing routes if cookie sessions are used
CORS allows only configured origins

tasks.title: Schema and migrations: projects, tasks, comments, labels
acceptance: Migrations apply on top of T07's
Foreign keys and indexes for workspace_id, project_id and assignee_id

tasks.title: Workspaces API: CRUD, invitations, role changes
acceptance: Only owners and admins can invite or change roles (tests prove denial)
Invitation tokens are single-use and expire

tasks.title: Projects API
acceptance: CRUD with policy checks
Members cannot see projects of workspaces they don't belong to (test)

tasks.title: Tasks API: CRUD, assignment, status workflow
acceptance: Status transitions follow the shared workflow; invalid transitions return 422
Assignee must be a workspace member
List endpoint is paginated

tasks.title: Comments API with @mentions
acceptance: Create, edit and delete own comments; admins can delete any
Mentions resolve to workspace members only

tasks.title: Labels API
acceptance: Labels are scoped to a project
Attach and detach labels on tasks with policy checks

tasks.title: Task search and filtering
acceptance: Filter by status, assignee, label and text
Queries use indexes (EXPLAIN output captured in the PR notes)

tasks.title: Activity and audit log
acceptance: Task and comment changes produce activity entries
Audit entries are append-only

tasks.title: Email notifications through a provider adapter
acceptance: Mentions and assignments enqueue emails
Provider is behind an interface with a fake used in tests
No email addresses or message bodies in logs

tasks.title: OpenAPI spec and API reference
acceptance: Spec is served at /openapi.json and validates against the OpenAPI 3 schema
docs/api/ generated from the spec

tasks.title: Design-system primitives (button, input, modal, toast)
acceptance: Components are keyboard accessible and labelled
Component tests cover states (disabled, error, loading)

tasks.title: Typed API client
acceptance: Requests and responses are validated with the shared schemas
Errors map to one typed error shape

tasks.title: Auth screens: signup, login, logout
acceptance: Forms validate inline and show server errors
No credentials stored in localStorage

tasks.title: Session handling and protected routes
acceptance: Unauthenticated users are redirected to login
Logout clears client state

tasks.title: Workspace switcher and settings
acceptance: Switching workspace reloads scoped data
Role-restricted settings are hidden and also rejected by the API

tasks.title: Projects list and creation
acceptance: Empty, loading and error states covered by tests

tasks.title: Kanban task board
acceptance: Drag and drop changes status through the API with optimistic update and rollback on failure
Board is usable with the keyboard

tasks.title: Task detail drawer with comments
acceptance: Edit fields inline
Comment thread with mentions autocomplete

tasks.title: Labels and filter bar
acceptance: Filters are reflected in the URL and survive reload

tasks.title: Activity feed
acceptance: Feed paginates and shows who changed what

tasks.title: Notification preferences UI
acceptance: Users can opt out per notification type

tasks.title: Accessibility audit of the core screens
tasks.description: Review only (lens: accessibility). The manager turns confirmed issues into follow-up tasks.
acceptance: Report lists WCAG 2.2 AA issues with file:line and a suggested fix
Each issue rated by severity

tasks.title: End-to-end tests for the core flows
acceptance: Signup -> create workspace -> project -> task -> comment flow passes headless
Tests are stable across 3 consecutive runs

tasks.title: Seed data and demo script
acceptance: `pnpm --filter api seed` creates a demo workspace idempotently

tasks.title: Container images and local docker-compose
acceptance: `docker compose up` starts db, api and web; /health is green
Images run as a non-root user

tasks.title: Deploy pipeline
acceptance: Deploy runs only from main after CI passes
Secrets come from the CI secret store, never the repo
Migrations run before the new version takes traffic

tasks.title: Threat model and security review of auth and workspace flows
acceptance: Report covers session handling, authorization, invitations, rate limits and data exposure
Every finding has a severity, a location and a fix

tasks.title: README, CHANGELOG and architecture overview
acceptance: Every command in the README was run successfully
Architecture doc matches the code (module list, data flow)
